title: CANcestry HAL configuration (v0.1.0)
description: Schema for the CANcestry Hardware Abstraction Layer configuration file (Phase 6, issue #17). Declares the set of physical CAN interfaces the gateway binds at startup, their bitrates, and optional listen-only mode. All strings must validate against this schema before being accepted by the runtime; configuration that fails validation is refused (fail-closed). Phase 7 (issue #20) adds the optional per-interface can_fd and data_bitrate fields; documents without them validate exactly as before.

name.description: OS interface name (e.g., 'can0', 'vcan1'). Must match SIOCGIFINDEX naming rules.

interface_id.description: CANcestry logical interface id used by codecs, recipes and FSMs. Must be unique within the configuration.

bitrate.description: Nominal bitrate in bits per second. 125000, 250000, 500000 are typical CAN values.

listen_only.description: When true the interface is opened in listen-only mode; hal_send_tx returns ERR_NO_INTERFACE for this interface.

can_fd.description: When true the HAL asks the platform for CAN FD on this interface (CAN_RAW_FD_FRAMES on Linux). The request is best-effort: if the interface does not support CAN FD it stays classic-only and every CAN FD frame is rejected with a PROTOCOL_UNSUPPORTED fault instead of being truncated (SW-FR-CANFD-003/004). Additive, optional field introduced by Phase 7 (issue #20).

data_bitrate.description: CAN FD data-phase bitrate in bits per second; only meaningful when can_fd is true. The value is declarative: the data bitrate is a property of the interface (set with `ip link set <if> type can dbitrate <n> fd on`), and the HAL uses a non-zero value to request bit-rate switching (CANFD_BRS) on transmitted FD frames.
